description: Use to find the right metric slug before get_metric_series or get_chart. The full metric catalog: slug, label, unit, basis (daily/monthly/annual/quarterly/ttm — the stored sampling density, never overstated), methodology, and whether each metric is available as a JSON series (get_metric_series) and/or a chart render (get_chart). The same dictionary is the resource tgmcharts://metrics.

format.description: json (default): the full JSON as text. markdown: a compact table or list, fewer tokens. structuredContent is the full JSON either way.

name: list_metrics
title: List available metrics
